build_dialogpt_agent: build a DialoGPT dialogue agent using the DialogptAgent class with small, medium, or large model size
run_dialogpt_decoder: run the DialoGPTDecoder to decode text using a pretrained Hugging Face DialoGPT model
init_dialogpt_model: initialize a DialoGPTModel from pretrained Microsoft DialoGPT weights via the _init_from_pretrained method
configure_dialogpt_args: configure DialoGPT command line arguments including gpt2-size, delimiter, and truncation settings via add_cmdline_args
get_dialogpt_special_tokens: get the null, start, and end special token indices for DialoGPT using the _get_special_tokens method
